name: Kilo Code
verdict: A free open-source coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains, and the CLI; individuals pay model usage, and Teams is $15 a seat.
pros: The editor extensions and CLI are free for individuals
BYOK, local models, and a gateway at provider rates
Cloud compute is billed per second
cons: Model usage, Kilo Pass, and cloud compute are separate bills
Credit purchases add a 5% processing fee
pricingNote: Checked 2026-10-16 on kilocode.ai/pricing. Individual platform access is free and open source for VS Code, JetBrains, and the CLI, with usage billed separately. Teams is $15 per user a month and includes a 14-day Enterprise trial. Enterprise is Custom. Inference is separate: Auto Free, BYOK, or local is $0 a month; Kilo Gateway is $0 a month plus usage at exact provider rates; Kilo Pass lists Starter at $19 a month, Pro at $49 a month, and Expert at $199 a month. The comparison table lists a 5% processing fee on credit purchases. Cloud compute on the same page: Code Review $0.33 an hour, Cloud Agent Docker and Small $0.60 an hour, Cloud Agent Standard $1.20 an hour, billed per second, with inference charged separately. The Pass calculator also shows bonus-credit illustrations and a 12-month "you pay" example that changes with the selected tier, so that example total is not a plan row.
